role: Template listing the environment variables scripts/run_tests_with_coverage.sh reads (SCHEME, PROJECT, MIN_COVERAGE, DESTINATION); says nothing loads it and how to export it.
toplevel: Data only. Header says the variables are read from the environment by scripts/run_tests_with_coverage.sh, that nothing loads a .env file, and that a copy must be exported into the shell (`set -a; . ./.env; set +a`) or set inline, else it is ignored. SCHEME=Emuqu, PROJECT=Emuqu.xcodeproj. Comments name the three committed coverage floors (.ci/min_coverage.txt, .ci/min_coverage_logic.txt, .ci/min_coverage_views.txt), say MIN_COVERAGE overrides the overall floor and that any value below it loosens the gate, so no example value is given. Optional commented DESTINATION=id=<simulator-id>. .gitignore ignores .env/.env.local/.env.*.local. scripts/run_tests_with_coverage.sh:6-9 reads SCHEME/PROJECT/RESULT_BUNDLE/MIN_COVERAGE with defaults and honours an exported DESTINATION (else select_simulator_destination.sh).
